comment.narrative: Two years after its establishment the YAP showed excellent success in upholding its mandate by representing Palestinian young peoples interests and echoing their voices at the decisionmaking tables of both national and international key development partners. To support the YAP in their mission UNFPA and other sponsoring partners such as the Danish Representative Office and the EU in Palestine have funded additional capacitybuilding training for the YAP members in their second year. During the reporting period YAP members participated in a number of workshops covering a variety of aspects related to their work including Communication Networking Negotiation strategies public speaking Diplomacy and Advocacy Skills. The workshops were conducted by our consulting partner Suitable Development Forum Tana Copenhagen Institute and the Danish International Development Agency DANIDA. In addition a number of YAP members have participated in two separate visits to Copenhagen Denmark to participate in DANIDA Fellowship Center training on SDGs Policy and advocacy and to attend an official invitation by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark to meet with a diverse range of youth human rights institutions Danish civil society organizations and official bodies like the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Danish Parliament. Moreover YAP members have gained exposure to a number of UNorganized local regional and international forums. YAP members Firas Bethlehem and Nada Ramallah participated in the annual Economic and Social Council ECOSOC Youth Forum in New York in April 2023. Islam Gaza Siwar Tulkarem and Kutaybah East Jerusalem participated as guest speakers in the 6th session titled Investing in Youth Potential of the National Population Conference in July 2023. Tamara Tulkarem has participated in the local and regional evaluation committees for UNODCs Youth for Impact project in September 2023. Islam Gaza participated in the 13th edition of the UNESCO Youth Forum held in Paris in November 2023. Most recently Atta Gaza arrived at Texas USA in February 2024 to participate in IREXs Community Engagement Exchange Program for the duration of 3 months.Operationalizing the YAPs mandate by ensuring that Palestinian youth views are meaningfully taken into consideration by key relevant stakeholders has been remarkable. The YAP members were involved in a number of policy dialogues where they expressed Palestinian youth voices on multiple decisionmaking tables with the UNCT and UN agencies the EU and member states and the governmental sectors relevant partners such as the Higher Council for Youth and Sports where UNFPA introduced the YAP to the HCYS deputy minister and other meetings followed related to the development of the national youth strategy 20252030. In June 2023 the YAP attended a meeting with the United Nations Country Team composed of the UN Resident Coordinator and Palestine and the Head of Agencies to discuss possible collaboration on matters concerning amplifying Palestinian youth voices. The meeting was followed by bilateral meetings with representatives and heads of different specialized UN agencies like the WFP UNFPA among others. In addition YAP members had the chance to interact with UNFPAs Regional Director for Arab States Ms. Laila Baker during her visit to the Palestine. In the same month YAP had a fruitful meeting with the Heads of the Political Section HoPs of the EU in Palestine to discuss potential cooperation on essential youth issues. As an outcome of this meeting the YAP in collaboration with the EU officials in Palestine has achieved a draft concept note for a standard operating procedure for integrating Palestinian youths in decisionmaking and programplanning process with the EU.
